recap: Nifty 50 ended at 25,144.30 (-0.61%) and the Sensex at 81,592.45 (-0.39%); Bank Nifty moved -0.79%.
By size: large caps (Nifty 100) -0.65%, mid caps (Midcap 150) -0.35%, small caps (Smallcap 250) -0.30%.
FIIs were net buyers of ₹5,737 cr and DIIs net sellers of ₹2,254 cr (provisional, NSE).
Energy led the sectors (+0.03%), while Realty lagged (-1.39%).
Top Nifty 500 gainer was Hitachi Energy India (+10.68%); biggest faller was Techno Electric (-5.64%). Breadth: 160 advances vs 339 declines.
Overseas, the S&P 500 last closed down 0.35% and the Nasdaq down 0.39%.
The rupee is at 94.22 per dollar, Brent at $96.73 (+0.95%) and gold at $3,890 (+0.13%).
